Definition: from G4862 and G5585; to compute jointly:--reckon.
BiblicalUsage: At Ephesus many who used curious arts bring their books together and burn them, and they count the price and find it fifty thousand pieces of silver. Counting the cost of leaving the old life is part of repentance, and the pile of ashes is worth more than the price of the books.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that leaving sin behind is worth whatever it costs, and I believe a counted cost, paid gladly, is the proof the break is real.
